SELECT ai.*, (SELECT m.model_type FROM AI_MODEL m WHERE m.model_key = ai.model_key AND m.env_code <=> ai.env_code AND (m.deleted = 0 OR m.deleted IS NULL) LIMIT 1) AS model_type, ( SELECT se.avatar FROM AI_MODEL m JOIN SYSTEM_EXTENSION se ON se.env_code = ai.env_code AND (se.deleted = 0 OR se.deleted IS NULL) AND (se.provider_code = m.provider OR se.extension_key = m.provider) WHERE m.model_key = ai.model_key AND m.env_code <=> ai.env_code AND (m.deleted = 0 OR m.deleted IS NULL) AND m.provider IS NOT NULL AND m.provider != '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN se.provider_code = m.provider THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1 ) AS providerAvatar FROM AI_INSTANCE ai WHERE (ai.deleted = 0 OR ai.deleted IS NULL)
AND ai.instance_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.instanceKey}, '%')
AND ai.instance_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.instanceName}, '%')
AND ai.model_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.modelKey}, '%')
AND ai.status = #{req.status}
AND ai.env_code = #{req.envCode}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM AI_MODEL m WHERE m.model_key = ai.model_key AND m.env_code = ai.env_code AND m.model_type = #{req.modelType} AND (m.deleted = 0 OR m.deleted IS NULL) )
ORDER BY ai.create_time DESC

SELECT ai.*, (SELECT m.model_type FROM AI_MODEL m WHERE m.model_key = ai.model_key AND m.env_code <=> ai.env_code AND (m.deleted = 0 OR m.deleted IS NULL) LIMIT 1) AS model_type, ( SELECT se.avatar FROM AI_MODEL m JOIN SYSTEM_EXTENSION se ON se.env_code = ai.env_code AND (se.deleted = 0 OR se.deleted IS NULL) AND (se.provider_code = m.provider OR se.extension_key = m.provider) WHERE m.model_key = ai.model_key AND m.env_code <=> ai.env_code AND (m.deleted = 0 OR m.deleted IS NULL) AND m.provider IS NOT NULL AND m.provider != '' ORDER BY CASE WHEN se.provider_code = m.provider THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1 ) AS providerAvatar FROM AI_INSTANCE ai WHERE ai.id = #{id} AND (ai.deleted = 0 OR ai.deleted IS NULL)
